subject: Whole Qwen3.5 GatedDeltaNet conv-backend parity PASS; GPU released
body: Corrected whole-module parity gate PASS. Identical Qwen3_5GatedDeltaNet weights and identical FLA gated-delta kernels; only causal-conv backend differed (PyTorch reference vs FLA Triton). Seq17/64 output relative-L2 0.00694/0.00666, grad_input 0.00853/0.00801, conv grad 0.00804/0.00741, QKV grad 0.00835/0.00784, out-proj grad 0.00687/0.00666; all cosine ~0.99996-0.99998 and finite. Receipt SHA d864e3a2343d5e8ac373d1dfa1892518ad066d2ec7839c2be076c160a776cc1f. No weights changed. Next gate: whole-model nonmutating backward on exact reserved rows with backend fla_triton_full versus existing fla_triton reference-conv baseline. GPU released.
